application.name: Namida
application.summary: Beautiful music & video player with YouTube support
application.desc:
A Beautiful and Feature-rich Music & Video Player with YouTube Support, built in Flutter.
Everything you might expect from a music player, plus:
Library & Indexing * Powerful Indexer & Tag Editor * Artists and Genres Separators * Prevent Duplicated Tracks * Set Minimum File Size & Duration * Folders-based Library system with exclusion support * Sort by almost any property of the track or album
Look & Feel * Material3-like Theme * Dynamic Theming (player colors picked from current album artwork) * Home, Tracks, Albums, Artists, Genres, Playlists, Queues and Folders pages * Waveform Seekbar * Lots of customizations
Sound * Parametric Equalizer with AutoEQ import * Bit-perfect Playback & USB DAC Direct Access * High precision 32-bit float audio * Audio Path viewer * Output Device Selection & Mono Audio * Crossfade, Gapless Playback, Play/Pause Fade Effect & Skip Silence * Speed & Pitch Control (semitones & 432Hz) & Loudness Enhancer * Per-track Sound Settings * Replay Gain (Normalize Audio)
Streaming & YouTube * Best Video & Audio Quality * Audio Only & Data Saver Mode * Support Downloads, Caching & Offline Playback * Video View with gesture support (swipe to control volume, double tap to seek, pinch to fullscreen, long press for 1.5x speed) * SponsorBlock & Return YouTube Dislike Integration * Segments and Heatmap for videos * Cache Priority System * Optional auto title/artist/album extraction for downloads and scrobbling * Multi Library Support (Local / YT / Subsonic / Jellyfin / WebDAV / SMB)
Others * Lyrics auto fetching & displaying (Synced & Plain) + Word Synced lrc/ttml support * Sleep Timer (Tracks or Minutes) * Control pausing scenarios (calls, notifications, volume 0, etc.) * Search tracks by title, artist, album, filename, even lyrics * Global Tracks Selection * Persistent and reliable queue system * Reliable History System with minimum seconds/percentage to count a listen * Most Played Playlist * Custom Playlists Order & Custom artworks * Auto Import Playlists from M3U files & Music Web Servers * Left & Right swipe actions for tracks and videos * Artwork Gestures (tap and long press) * Support for cover.jpg images for folders & .info.txt for small info * Sync between devices over local network (history, playlists, favourites, queues, lyrics, caches)
Additional Cool Features * Smort Tracks Generation (based on listening history, time range, ratings, moods) * Animating Thumbnail (reacts to current audio peak) * Miniplayer Party Mode (edge breathing effect, dynamic colors) * Particles Effect (speed up with audio peak) * Track Play Mode (play selected, search results, album, artist, or genre) * Insert after latest inserted * Repeat for N times (in addition to normal repeat modes) * Extract feat. & ft. artists to their own entries * "Lost Memories" — meet tracks you listened to around this time, N years ago * "Recommended" tracks addition in queue * "Similar Release Date" tracks addition in queue * Import YouTube History, LastFM, Spotify & ListenBrainz
Video Integration * Full video library indexing & playback (since v4.0.0) * Videos can be played independently or alongside music * Dedicated videos folder view * Videos can be fetched from YouTube automatically
Permissions Explained * WAKE_LOCK, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK — keep app alive for media playback * INTERNET — for artist/album images, streaming & downloading * READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE (Android ≤ 12) — list files from indexer folders only * READ_MEDIA_AUDIO, READ_MEDIA_VIDEO, READ_MEDIA_IMAGES (Android 13+) — list media files from indexer folders * WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE (Android ≤ 10) — for file operations * MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE (Android 10+) — for editing tags, creating backups, saving artworks, deleting files, exporting playlists, downloading YouTube content * VIBRATE — haptic feedback (can be turned off) * POST_NOTIFICATIONS — progress notifications * REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS — improve downloads * WRITE_SETTINGS —
